prompt:
A high oblique DRONE establishing shot of a luxury mountain-road wedding journey at sunrise, portrait 9:16. Camera about 40 meters ABOVE the roadside overlook, well BACK, 20-25 degrees below horizontal, wide 24 mm lens. Lavender-peach sky and layered misty ridges fill the upper third. Strong diagonal sunshafts cut through waterfall mist; crisp rim-lit grass, deep rock shadows.

ONE pale sage-green vintage convertible with tan seats is already PARKED EMPTY in a gravel turnout at lower LEFT. Engine off, all four tires fixed against visible stones, doors shut. No people inside or near it; no logos or plate words. A cream scarf is tied to the passenger headrest. Camera motion alone changes the car's screen position.

The road descends visibly from this turnout along the SAME left cliff to ONE rectangular ivory wedding stage beside the waterfall pool, already identifiable in the lower-middle distance. Its three staggered ivory sail panels, two asymmetric white-orchid arrangements and broad low steps remain the exact destination throughout the descent. Waterfall stays RIGHT, road LEFT; fixed geography, no different landscape behind a wipe. Show the stage top clearly from this angle, small in the wide landscape.

Sunlit mist beads and a few pale grass seeds hang irregularly across near, middle and far depths. The clear flight line leaves the empty car behind and follows the visible road shoulder down to the stage, then levels over the steps. No moving vehicle, people, religious statues or extra stage. Premium animated natural materials and light, no text at this distant scale. The stage is outdoors with open cliffs and sky, never enclosed.
